measured_under.note: Every sensitivity below is CONDITIONAL on these, and they are settings a user can change. F9 opens Cutscene Mode's camera editor, which shows them; both read 1.0 when this was calibrated on 2026-08-28. Change either and the constants scale with it -- re-run tools/camera_calib.ps1.

fov_v_deg.source: measured 2026-08-28: median over 20 shots whose two independent focal-length readings agreed, spread 1.94 deg

yaw_deg_per_px.source: measured 2026-08-28: 3 consecutive step(s) against the target in tools/camera_probe.py

pitch_deg_per_px.source: measured 2026-08-28: 2 consecutive step(s) against the target in tools/camera_probe.py

pitch_min_deg.source: assumed; CLAUDE.md records only that the pitch clamps at both ends and that a drag against the clamp looks like a dead input

pitch_max_deg.source: measured 2026-08-28: walked into the top of the pitch range until it stopped responding -- pitchstop_3, pitchstop_4, pitchstop_5 agreed within 0.01 (residuals 9.5, 9.3, 9.0 px)

dist_scale_per_tick.source: measured 2026-08-28: 2 consecutive step(s) against the target in tools/camera_probe.py

dist_max.source: measured 2026-08-28: walked into the top of Ctrl+scroll until it stopped responding -- diststop_2, diststop_3, diststop_4 agreed within 0.04 (residuals 1.2, 1.4, 1.4 px)

pan_gain.source: measured: a 462 px right-drag moved the world 245 px (CLAUDE.md, Tiling)

fly_speed_max.source: measured 2026-08-28: 3 WASD holds, 0.08s->1.4t, 0.14s->2.2t, 0.14s->2.9t -- over holds of 0.08-0.14 s only; do NOT extrapolate

fly_ramp_tau.source: measured 2026-08-28: fitted with fly_speed_max over the same holds -- over holds of 0.08-0.14 s only; do NOT extrapolate
